build_autotrain_package: build the autotrain-advanced python package using setuptools with all dependencies from requirements.txt
install_autotrain_dev: install autotrain-advanced with dev extras including black isort flake8 and pytest
install_autotrain_client: install autotrain-advanced with client extras including requests and loguru
configure_entry_points: configure the autotrain console script entry point pointing to autotrain.cli.autotrain main function
review_setup_config: review the setup.py configuration for autotrain-advanced including classifiers keywords and data files
